title: Nutty Russian Peas Borscht
description: A festive and flavorful vegan Russian dish featuring sautéed peas, carrots, and beets, topped with a nutty cheese pull.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the beets and carrots and sauté for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the thyme, peas, and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the nutritional yeast and apple cider vinegar.
Transfer the mixture to individual bowls and top with a dollop of the nutty cheese pull (see below).
To make the cheese pull, blend the nutritional yeast with 1 tablespoon of water until smooth and creamy.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese pull forms and stretches like melted mozzarella.
Serve the borscht hot, topped with the nutty cheese pull and garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
